setup: cd "$VICOA_WORKTREE_PATH/backend" && { [ -d .venv ] || "$(command -v python3.11 || command -v python3)" -m venv .venv; } && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r src/backend/requirements.txt -r src/servers/requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt && echo 'backend venv ready'
echo '--- linking backend/postgres-data -> main (shared dev DB) ---'

[ -d "$VICOA_ROOT_PATH/backend/postgres-data" ] && ln -sfn "$VICOA_ROOT_PATH/backend/postgres-data" "$VICOA_WORKTREE_PATH/backend/postgres-data" && echo 'linked postgres-data -> main' || echo 'skip: main DB not initialized yet'
